policy: One primary category per operation, chosen by what it does. Manual chapters guide the grouping; example workflows support operations without a dedicated manual entry.

categories.name: Geometry & shells
categories.description: Combine or subtract geometry, add shells and surface plates, and reinforce the outer boundary.

categories.name: Lattices & transitions
categories.description: Define lattice units, add or subtract lattice infill, and blend lattice designs using planes or attractors.

categories.name: Volume meshing
categories.description: Create volume meshes for primitive shapes or input geometry using Cartesian, tetrahedral, Voronoi or layered methods.

categories.name: Surface meshing
categories.description: Generate quadrilateral surface meshes or remesh a triangular surface.

categories.name: Mesh processing
categories.description: Trim, refine, deform, map or extract surfaces from an existing mesh, including adjustments driven by a field.

categories.name: Lines & paths
categories.description: Generate curves, streamlines, contour lines and branching structures, including their material seed points.

categories.name: Fields
categories.description: Create or modify scalar, vector and grid fields; control boundaries, offsets, thickness and local features.

categories.name: Analysis & FEA
categories.description: Check geometry, evaluate field values at points, and generate a lattice mesh for finite element analysis.

categories.name: Import, export & storage
categories.description: Read or export models and meshes, manage stored mesh data, and save or restore compressed lattice field data.
